name: Spoken Brief shared voice qualification set

lines.text: The implementation is ready for review, and no generation will repeat automatically.
Should we merge the migration before the queue recovers, or keep the two changes separate?
Taskdeck, NavSentinel, Local Asset Studio, ComfyUI, Qwen three TTS, and pull request six hundred and thirty-six.
The run produced seventeen segments, forty-eight kilohertz mono audio, and a SHA two hundred and fifty-six receipt.
Open the handoffs folder, select COMPRESSED dot M D, and inspect the spoken output directory.

We selected the review-first coordinator because it preserves every child project identity, blocks duplicate inference after an uncertain response, and allows the final audio to be rebuilt from verified segments, but a real workstation trial is still required before pronunciation, pacing, listener fatigue, or the intended voice identity can be accepted.
The source stayed stable, every contract passed, and the listening file is ready for a careful owner review.
